destinations.name: Aitutaki

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.blurb: Whitewashed villages on the rim of a flooded volcano.

destinations.name: Athens
destinations.blurb: The Acropolis above a sprawl of tavernas, markets and street art.

destinations.name: Mykonos

destinations.name: Maafushi

destinations.name: Lagos
